newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Jan 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Chevron Corp's Chevron Chemical Co and Saudi Industrial Venture Capital Group to set up a 50-50 joint venture company to build and operate a $650 million petrochemical complex in Jubail on March 29.
- The real estate market rebounds in Saudi Arabia's eastern province.
- Qassim Cement Company posts pre-tax profits of 152 million riyals in 1996.
- Saudi real estate firm plans to build a shopping mall in Riyadh at a cost of 339 million riyals.
